dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) API catalogue

evidence_slice: GOV.UK API Catalogue entry 'National Heritage List for England (NHLE)' identifies Historic England's official API endpoint, states the NHLE is the only official up-to-date register of nationally protected historic buildings and sites in England, uses British National Grid EPSG:27700, contains points and polygons for Listed Buildings, and is updated daily under the Open Government Licence. The selected catalogue window does not expose any individual Exeter feature, polygon coordinate sequence, or record-bound type/use evidence.

field_evidence.footprint: Catalogue metadata states the NHLE service contains polygons, but this window exposes no individual Exeter polygon coordinate sequence.
field_evidence.type_use: Catalogue metadata identifies Listed Buildings as a protected-asset class, but exposes no selected Exeter record with explicit building name/type/use bound to geometry.
field_evidence.api: Official endpoint is https://services-eu1.arcgis.com/ZOdPfBS3aqqDYPUQ/arcgis/rest/services/National_Heritage_List_for_England_NHLE_v02_VIEW/FeatureServer; catalogue states British National Grid EPSG:27700 and daily updates.
